mapper.select: SELECT idempotency_record_id, user_id, operation, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, resource_type, resource_id, response_status, response_body, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM idempotency_records WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND operation = #{operation} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_records ( idempotency_record_id, user_id, operation, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, resource_type, resource_id, response_status, response_body, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{idempotencyRecordId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{operation}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{responseStatus}, #{responseBody, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_records SET status = 'COMPLETED', resource_type = #{resourceType}, resource_id = #{resourceId, jdbcType=CHAR}, response_status = #{responseStatus}, response_body = #{responseBody, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE idempotency_record_id = #{idempotencyRecordId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

UPDATE idempotency_records SET status = 'FAILED', response_status = #{responseStatus}, response_body = #{responseBody, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE idempotency_record_id = #{idempotencyRecordId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
